sentences.structure: 介词短语作时间状语 + 主句（主语 + 谓语 + 宾语 + 介词短语）
sentences.analysis: 句首的'After a long and messy campaign today'是时间状语，主句为'Democratic voters will decide between...'，其中'between...or...'是固定搭配，表示在两者之间选择。

sentences.en: There is a reason why Republicans are already spending thousands and thousands of dollars meddling in this primary, trying to maybe get their preferred candidate.
sentences.cn: 共和党人已经花费大量资金干预这次初选，试图得到他们偏好的候选人，这是有原因的。
sentences.structure: There be 句型 + 定语从句（why引导）+ 现在分词短语作状语
sentences.analysis: 'There is a reason'是主句，'why Republicans are already spending...'是定语从句修饰'reason'，其中'spending...meddling...'是现在分词短语作伴随状语，'trying to...'是目的状语。

sentences.en: But even as that happens, we've seen these races like Michigan, where we're starting to see some doubts creep in.
sentences.cn: 但即使如此，我们也看到了像密歇根这样的竞选，那里开始出现一些疑虑。
sentences.structure: 让步状语从句（even as）+ 主句 + 非限制性定语从句（where）
sentences.analysis: 'even as that happens'是让步状语从句，主句为'we've seen these races like Michigan'，'where'引导非限制性定语从句修饰'Michigan'，'creep in'意为'悄悄出现'。

sentences.en: And if they're not winning these swing states and these blue states, the map is just very tough for them as far as winning a Democratic Senate majority.
sentences.cn: 如果他们不能赢得这些摇摆州和蓝州，那么对于赢得民主党参议院多数席位来说，形势对他们非常严峻。
sentences.structure: 条件状语从句（if）+ 主句 + 介词短语（as far as）
sentences.analysis: 'if'引导条件状语从句，主句为'the map is just very tough for them'，'as far as'意为'就...而言'，后接动名词短语。

sentences.en: There's one thing, Audie, that cuts across all of these that I want to talk about this morning, which is this change electorate.
sentences.cn: 奥黛，有一件事贯穿所有这些，我今天早上想谈谈，那就是这个变化的选民群体。
sentences.structure: There be 句型 + 定语从句（that cuts across）+ 定语从句（that I want to talk about）+ 非限制性定语从句（which is）
sentences.analysis: 'There's one thing'是主句，'that cuts across all of these'是定语从句修饰'one thing'，'that I want to talk about'是另一个定语从句，'which is this change electorate'是非限制性定语从句补充说明。

sentences.en: I think a lot of our problems in our politics right now are downstream from the fact that on the right, you've sort of got one guy who's in charge, who's a boss, and a lot of ideological diversity that's allowed to work around his orbit, so long as you kiss that ring and then over on the left, no one who's necessarily in charge.
sentences.cn: 我认为我们当前政治中的许多问题都源于这样一个事实：在右翼，你有一个负责的人，一个老板，并且允许许多意识形态的多样性在他的轨道上运作，只要你表示效忠；而在左翼，没有人真正负责。
sentences.structure: 主句（I think...）+ 宾语从句（a lot of...are downstream from the fact）+ 同位语从句（that on the right...）+ 并列结构（and then over on the left...）
sentences.analysis: 这是一个复杂句，'I think'后接宾语从句，'the fact'后接同位语从句解释事实内容，其中包含'who'引导的定语从句和'so long as'引导的条件状语从句，最后用'and then'连接左翼的情况。

sentences.en: The mainstream Democrats, like the Haley Stevens of the party, haven't really been able to run effective campaigns against the more radical flank, because they're not willing to say what they're for that the DSA left is against.
sentences.cn: 主流民主党人，比如党内的海利·史蒂文斯，一直未能真正有效地对抗更激进的派系，因为他们不愿意说出他们支持而民主社会主义者左翼反对的东西。
sentences.structure: 主句（The mainstream Democrats...haven't been able to run...）+ 原因状语从句（because...）+ 宾语从句（what they're for）+ 定语从句（that the DSA left is against）
sentences.analysis: 主句主语是'The mainstream Democrats'，'like the Haley Stevens of the party'是插入语，'because'引导原因状语从句，其中'what they're for'是宾语从句，'that the DSA left is against'是定语从句修饰'what'。

sentences.en: And I think that's why you see the UAW endorsed him.
sentences.cn: 我认为这就是为什么你看到UAW支持他。
sentences.structure: 主句（I think）+ 宾语从句（that's why...）
sentences.analysis: 'I think'后接宾语从句，'that's why'引导表语从句，表示原因。

sentences.en: But again, to your point, it's because it's Michigan.
sentences.cn: 但再次，你说得对，这是因为密歇根州。
sentences.structure: 插入语（to your point）+ 主句（it's because...）
sentences.analysis: 'to your point'是插入语，意为'就你的观点而言'，主句是'it's because it's Michigan'，其中'because'引导表语从句。

sentences.en: And that's why you see that.
sentences.cn: 这就是为什么你看到这种情况。
sentences.structure: 主句（that's why...）
sentences.analysis: 'that's why'引导表语从句，表示原因。

sentences.en: I think Abdullah El-Sayed is winning, because he's running a virulently anti-Israel campaign, as you said, Audie.
sentences.cn: 我认为阿卜杜勒·埃尔-萨耶德正在获胜，因为他正在进行一场恶毒的反以色列竞选，正如你所说，奥黛。
sentences.structure: 主句（I think...）+ 宾语从句（Abdullah El-Sayed is winning）+ 原因状语从句（because...）+ 插入语（as you said）
sentences.analysis: 'I think'后接宾语从句，'because'引导原因状语从句，'as you said'是插入语，表示引用。

sentences.en: I don't think it's because he's talking about bringing manufacturing back to Michigan.
sentences.cn: 我不认为这是因为他在谈论将制造业带回密歇根。
sentences.structure: 主句（I don't think）+ 宾语从句（it's because...）
sentences.analysis: 'I don't think'后接宾语从句，'because'引导表语从句，表示原因。

sentences.en: And I want to give the last word to Aaron, because Bernie Sanders, when I think of him grumpy with his arms crossed at that DNC many years ago.
sentences.cn: 我想让亚伦说最后一句话，因为伯尼·桑德斯，当我想到多年前他在民主党全国代表大会上双臂交叉、脾气暴躁的样子。
sentences.structure: 主句（I want to give...）+ 原因状语从句（because...）+ 时间状语从句（when I think of...）
sentences.analysis: 主句是'I want to give the last word to Aaron'，'because'引导原因状语从句，其中'when I think of him grumpy...'是时间状语从句，'grumpy with his arms crossed'是形容词短语作补语。

sentences.en: The reason is because the Democratic primary electorate has proven willing to elect these kinds of candidates.
sentences.cn: 原因是民主党初选选民已经证明愿意选举这类候选人。
sentences.structure: 主句（The reason is）+ 表语从句（because...）
sentences.analysis: 'The reason is'后接表语从句，'because'引导表语从句，说明原因。

sentences.en: They haven't gotten these candidates, necessarily, through primaries in marquee races, in swing electorates.
sentences.cn: 他们不一定能让这些候选人通过重要竞选的初选，在摇摆选民中。
sentences.structure: 主句（They haven't gotten...）+ 插入语（necessarily）+ 介词短语（through primaries...）
sentences.analysis: 主句是'They haven't gotten these candidates'，'necessarily'是插入语，'through primaries in marquee races, in swing electorates'是介词短语作方式状语。

sentences.en: So, getting Abdul el-Sayed through this primary and having him tested in a general election that is going to have lots of focus in November, is a big moment for this movement.
sentences.cn: 因此，让阿卜杜勒·埃尔-萨耶德通过这次初选，并让他在11月备受关注的普选中接受考验，对这个运动来说是一个重要时刻。
sentences.structure: 动名词短语作主语（getting...and having...）+ 系动词（is）+ 表语（a big moment）+ 定语从句（that is going to...）
sentences.analysis: 主语是两个并列的动名词短语'getting Abdul el-Sayed through this primary'和'having him tested in a general election'，'that is going to have lots of focus in November'是定语从句修饰'general election'。

sentences.en: They need to prove that they can win in that kind of environment, not just primaries, but general elections with swing electorates.
sentences.cn: 他们需要证明他们能在那种环境中获胜，不仅仅是初选，而是有摇摆选民的普选。
sentences.structure: 主句（They need to prove）+ 宾语从句（that they can win...）+ 并列结构（not just...but...）
sentences.analysis: 'They need to prove'后接宾语从句，'not just...but...'是并列结构，强调不仅仅是初选，而是普选。

sentences.en: Now, Grassley had asked him to testify on September 22nd, if approved by the Justice Department.
sentences.cn: 现在，格拉斯利曾要求他在9月22日作证，如果得到司法部批准的话。
sentences.structure: 主句（Grassley had asked him to testify...）+ 条件状语从句（if approved...）
sentences.analysis: 主句是'Grassley had asked him to testify on September 22nd'，'if approved by the Justice Department'是条件状语从句的省略形式，完整为'if he is approved by the Justice Department'。

sentences.en: Now, it's expected to include provisions to voluntarily allow the government to review new models before they release them.
sentences.cn: 现在，预计它将包括允许政府在新模型发布前自愿审查这些模型的规定。
sentences.structure: 主句（it's expected to include...）+ 不定式短语作定语（to voluntarily allow...）+ 时间状语从句（before they release them）
sentences.analysis: 'it's expected to include'是主句，'to voluntarily allow...'是不定式短语作定语修饰'provisions'，'before they release them'是时间状语从句。

sentences.en: Audio captures the moment the pilot warned that they wouldn't make it to the airport's runway.
sentences.cn: 音频捕捉到飞行员警告他们无法到达机场跑道的时刻。
sentences.structure: 主句（Audio captures the moment）+ 定语从句（the pilot warned...）
sentences.analysis: 'the moment'后接定语从句，省略了关系副词'when'，'warned'后接宾语从句'that they wouldn't make it...'。

sentences.en: She confirmed that she is taking a step back from public life.
sentences.cn: 她确认她正在退出公众生活。
sentences.structure: 主句（She confirmed）+ 宾语从句（that she is taking...）
sentences.analysis: 'She confirmed'后接宾语从句，'that'引导宾语从句，'take a step back from'意为'退出'。

sentences.en: So, what she told fans last night is that her decision is not reactive, and it's something that has been planned for some time.
sentences.cn: 所以，她昨晚告诉粉丝的是，她的决定不是被动的，而是已经计划了一段时间的事情。
sentences.structure: 主语从句（what she told fans last night）+ 系动词（is）+ 表语从句（that her decision is not reactive...）
sentences.analysis: 'what she told fans last night'是主语从句，'is'是系动词，'that'引导表语从句，其中包含'and'连接的并列结构。

sentences.en: But what I don't understand is Trump lashing out at Pirro.
sentences.cn: 但我不明白的是特朗普猛烈抨击皮罗。
sentences.structure: 主语从句（what I don't understand）+ 系动词（is）+ 表语（Trump lashing out at Pirro）
sentences.analysis: 'what I don't understand'是主语从句，'is'是系动词，'Trump lashing out at Pirro'是动名词复合结构作表语。

sentences.en: Why do you think she has come in for such criticism from him when she has gone after just about everyone, you know, that he has been frustrated with?
sentences.cn: 你为什么认为她受到他如此批评，而她已经追查了他几乎对每个人都感到沮丧的人？
sentences.structure: 特殊疑问句（Why do you think...）+ 宾语从句（she has come in for...）+ 时间状语从句（when she has gone after...）
sentences.analysis: 'Why do you think'是主句，后接宾语从句'she has come in for such criticism from him'，'when'引导时间状语从句，'you know'是插入语。

sentences.en: The problem is that we've seen this over and over again, over the last 18 months or so; is that when these theories actually have to be tested in court, that doesn't go very well.
sentences.cn: 问题是我们在过去18个月左右反复看到这种情况；当这些理论实际上必须在法庭上检验时，情况并不顺利。
sentences.structure: 主句（The problem is）+ 表语从句（that we've seen...）+ 分号连接另一个表语从句（is that when...）
sentences.analysis: 'The problem is'后接两个表语从句，用分号连接，第二个表语从句中'when'引导时间状语从句。

sentences.en: There was a lot of hemming and hawing about the fact that Donald Trump would not abide by the decisions of the Supreme Court or other courts at any point.
sentences.cn: 关于唐纳德·特朗普不会在任何时候遵守最高法院或其他法院的裁决这一事实，人们支支吾吾。
sentences.structure: There be 句型 + 介词短语（about the fact）+ 同位语从句（that Donald Trump would not abide by...）
sentences.analysis: 'There was a lot of hemming and hawing'是主句，'about the fact'是介词短语，'that'引导同位语从句解释'fact'的内容。

sentences.en: This administration is operating within the confines of the law and operating like it is bound to the law.
sentences.cn: 本届政府在法律范围内运作，并且像受法律约束一样运作。
sentences.structure: 主句（This administration is operating...and operating...）+ 方式状语从句（like it is bound to the law）
sentences.analysis: 主句有两个并列的谓语'is operating...and operating...'，'like'引导方式状语从句，意为'像...一样'。

sentences.en: I think this is someone who's been a pretty good soldier for the president and his administration.
sentences.cn: 我认为这是一个为总统和他的政府相当忠诚的人。
sentences.structure: 主句（I think）+ 宾语从句（this is someone...）+ 定语从句（who's been...）
sentences.analysis: 'I think'后接宾语从句，'who'引导定语从句修饰'someone'。

sentences.en: Remember the guy who went to Congress this week or last week, who wants a big job, who couldn't say that Joe Biden won the election because folks are scared to death to cross him?
sentences.cn: 还记得那个本周或上周去国会的人吗？他想要一个大职位，却不能说乔·拜登赢得了选举，因为人们害怕得罪他。
sentences.structure: 祈使句（Remember the guy）+ 定语从句（who went to Congress...）+ 定语从句（who wants a big job）+ 定语从句（who couldn't say...）+ 原因状语从句（because...）
sentences.analysis: 'Remember the guy'是祈使句，后面有三个'who'引导的定语从句修饰'the guy'，最后一个定语从句中'that'引导宾语从句，'because'引导原因状语从句。

sentences.en: And I think that, in any other time, if, you know -- when Democrats take over the -- the House, if they do in January, this is the kind of thing that you would want to have congressional hearings and issue subpoenas.
sentences.cn: 我认为，在任何其他时候，如果——你知道——当民主党接管众议院时，如果他们在一月份这样做，这就是你想要举行国会听证会并发出传票的那种事情。
sentences.structure: 主句（I think that...）+ 条件状语从句（if...when...）+ 主句（this is the kind of thing...）+ 定语从句（that you would want...）
sentences.analysis: 'I think that'后接宾语从句，其中包含'if'和'when'引导的状语从句，主句是'this is the kind of thing'，'that'引导定语从句。

sentences.en: But look, it's not the first time, and it won't be the last time that an administration looks to pursue a case that it knows it probably can't win in court.
sentences.cn: 但听着，这不是第一次，也不会是最后一次，一个政府试图追查一个它知道可能无法在法庭上获胜的案件。
sentences.structure: 并列句（it's not the first time, and it won't be the last time）+ 定语从句（that an administration looks to pursue...）+ 定语从句（that it knows...）
sentences.analysis: 这是一个并列句，'that'引导定语从句修饰'time'，其中包含另一个'that'引导的定语从句修饰'case'。

sentences.en: We had with the Biden administration, right? They attempted to wipe all student debt until the Supreme Court came along and said, actually, you can't really do that.
sentences.cn: 我们与拜登政府有过这种情况，对吧？他们试图免除所有学生债务，直到最高法院出现并说，实际上，你不能真的那样做。
sentences.structure: 省略句（We had with the Biden administration）+ 主句（They attempted to wipe...）+ 时间状语从句（until the Supreme Court came along and said...）
sentences.analysis: 'We had with the Biden administration'是省略句，完整为'We had this with the Biden administration'，主句是'They attempted to wipe all student debt'，'until'引导时间状语从句。

sentences.en: But each one of these is someone taking the time, doing the evidentiary work, going to court.
sentences.cn: 但每一个这些都是有人花时间，做证据工作，上法庭。
sentences.structure: 主句（each one of these is someone）+ 现在分词短语作定语（taking the time, doing the evidentiary work, going to court）
sentences.analysis: 主句是'each one of these is someone'，后面三个并列的现在分词短语修饰'someone'。

sentences.en: And at what point, if you're running a business and you're a businessperson, do you look around and say, I'm just -- this is creating problems.
sentences.cn: 在什么情况下，如果你经营一家企业，你是一个商人，你会环顾四周说，我只是——这正在制造问题。
sentences.structure: 特殊疑问句（at what point...do you look around and say...）+ 条件状语从句（if you're running...）
sentences.analysis: 'at what point'是疑问词，'if'引导条件状语从句，主句是'do you look around and say'，后接直接引语。

sentences.en: We've talked a lot about cost and corruption as we move into the midterms, and the thing that we're not talking about is we keep talking about this contractor.
sentences.cn: 随着我们进入中期选举，我们已经谈了很多关于成本和腐败的问题，而我们没有谈论的是我们一直在谈论这个承包商。
sentences.structure: 并列句（We've talked...and the thing...is...）+ 时间状语从句（as we move into the midterms）+ 定语从句（that we're not talking about）
sentences.analysis: 这是一个并列句，第一个分句有'as'引导的时间状语从句，第二个分句的主语是'the thing'，后接'that'引导的定语从句，'is'后接表语从句。

sentences.en: We have reported on this network that the contract was somebody that worked on a pool down at Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.cn: 我们在这个网络上报道过，合同是某个在海湖庄园修过游泳池的人。
sentences.structure: 主句（We have reported on this network）+ 宾语从句（that the contract was somebody...）+ 定语从句（that worked on a pool...）
sentences.analysis: 'We have reported'后接宾语从句，'that'引导宾语从句，其中'that worked on a pool...'是定语从句修饰'somebody'。

sentences.en: Now, I'm not saying any wrongdoing was done.
sentences.cn: 现在，我不是说有任何不当行为。
sentences.structure: 主句（I'm not saying）+ 宾语从句（any wrongdoing was done）
sentences.analysis: 'I'm not saying'后接宾语从句，'any wrongdoing was done'是宾语从句。

sentences.en: But it's just another thing that stacks up.
sentences.cn: 但这只是又一件累积起来的事情。
sentences.structure: 主句（it's just another thing）+ 定语从句（that stacks up）
sentences.analysis: 'that'引导定语从句修饰'thing'，'stack up'意为'累积'。

sentences.en: Michigan's primary shines a light on the deep divide in the Democratic Party and ask whether voters are choosing an ideology or candidate they think can win in November.
sentences.cn: 密歇根州的初选揭示了民主党内部的深刻分歧，并询问选民是在选择一种意识形态，还是选择他们认为能在十一月获胜的候选人。
sentences.structure: 主语（Michigan's primary）+ 谓语（shines a light on）+ 宾语（the deep divide）+ 并列谓语（and ask）+ 宾语从句（whether...）
sentences.analysis: 该句为并列句，第一个分句用短语'shines a light on'表示揭示，第二个分句用'ask'后接whether引导的宾语从句，从句中'choosing'后接两个并列宾语'ideology'和'candidate'，'candidate'后接定语从句'they think can win'。

sentences.en: It's a key test of where the party is headed.
sentences.cn: 这是对党未来走向的关键考验。
sentences.structure: 主语（It）+ 系动词（is）+ 表语（a key test）+ 介词短语（of where...）
sentences.analysis: 表语后接of介词短语，其中where引导名词性从句作of的宾语，表示'党走向何方'。

sentences.en: There's Haley Stevens making her final campaign pitch, framing herself as the pragmatic choice to take on Republican Mike Rogers in November.
sentences.cn: 海利·史蒂文斯正在进行最后的竞选宣传，将自己定位为十一月对抗共和党人迈克·罗杰斯的务实选择。
sentences.structure: There be 句型 + 现在分词短语（making...）作后置定语，其中包含另一个现在分词短语（framing...）作伴随状语
sentences.analysis: There be句型中，主语后接现在分词短语作定语，'framing herself as'是伴随状语，表示'将自己定位为'。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Abdul El-Sayed rallied Detroit progressives and mounted a direct challenge to the party's Washington establishment.
sentences.cn: 与此同时，阿卜杜勒·埃尔-萨耶德召集了底特律的进步派人士，对党的华盛顿建制派发起了直接挑战。
sentences.structure: 主语（Abdul El-Sayed）+ 并列谓语（rallied... and mounted...）
sentences.analysis: 两个并列谓语动词，'rallied'表示召集，'mounted a challenge to'表示发起挑战。

sentences.en: I believe in the opportunity we have in front of us to take our democracy back from the likes of the corporations and the billionaires and the special interests who want to tell us what we cannot have and should not fight for.
sentences.cn: 我相信我们面前的机会，将我们的民主从那些公司、亿万富翁和特殊利益集团手中夺回来，他们想告诉我们什么我们不能拥有，也不应该为之奋斗。
sentences.structure: 主句（I believe in the opportunity）+ 定语从句（we have...）+ 不定式短语（to take...）作目的状语，其中包含定语从句（who want...）修饰special interests
sentences.analysis: 该句结构复杂，'opportunity'后接定语从句'we have in front of us'，不定式短语表示目的，'from the likes of'后接三个并列名词，'who'引导定语从句修饰'special interests'，从句中'what'引导宾语从句。

sentences.en: West Michigan needs a senator who's going to deliver, who's going to show up, who's going to show you that I can campaign like I govern and I govern like I campaign, I'm present, I'm focused, I'm dedicated.
sentences.cn: 西密歇根需要一位能够兑现承诺、能够挺身而出、能够向你展示我像治理一样竞选、像竞选一样治理的参议员，我在场，我专注，我投入。
sentences.structure: 主句（West Michigan needs a senator）+ 三个并列定语从句（who's going to...）+ 宾语从句（that I can...）
sentences.analysis: 三个who引导的定语从句并列修饰senator，第三个定语从句中嵌套that引导的宾语从句，宾语从句中又包含两个并列分句，最后三个短句强调个人品质。

sentences.en: Since we have such a clear division between the folks who have lined up behind Abdul El-Sayed, progressives, AOC, Bernie Sanders and so on.
sentences.cn: 因为我们之间存在着如此明显的分歧，一边是支持阿卜杜勒·埃尔-萨耶德、进步派、AOC、伯尼·桑德斯等人。
sentences.structure: 原因状语从句（Since...）+ 主句（we have...）+ 定语从句（who have lined up...）
sentences.analysis: Since引导原因状语从句，主句为'we have such a clear division'，'between'后接两个并列名词短语，第一个名词短语后接who引导的定语从句。

sentences.en: And beyond that, you have very clear ideological divides when it comes to Israel, which, you know, in our post-October 7th environment has become such a huge dividing line among Democrats as they look to build the future of their party.
sentences.cn: 除此之外，在以色列问题上存在非常明显的意识形态分歧，你知道，在我们10月7日后的环境中，这已成为民主党内部一条巨大的分界线，因为他们希望建设党的未来。
sentences.structure: 主句（you have...）+ 时间状语从句（when it comes to...）+ 非限制性定语从句（which...has become...）+ 原因状语从句（as they look...）
sentences.analysis: 主句为'you have very clear ideological divides'，'when it comes to'表示'当涉及'，which引导非限制性定语从句修饰'Israel'，从句中插入'you know'，最后as引导原因状语从句。

sentences.en: And for all the talk of divisions within the Democratic Party, the electorate is actually pretty close.
sentences.cn: 尽管民主党内部存在种种分歧的说法，但选民实际上相当接近。
sentences.structure: 让步状语（for all the talk...）+ 主句（the electorate is...）
sentences.analysis: 'for all'表示'尽管'，引导让步状语，主句说明选民实际状况。

sentences.en: So, yeah, there's this huge divide they have on Israel, but the whole party is moving in El-Sayed direction on Israel.
sentences.cn: 所以，是的，他们在以色列问题上存在巨大分歧，但整个政党在以色列问题上正朝着埃尔-萨耶德的方向前进。
sentences.structure: 并列句（there's... but...）
sentences.analysis: 两个分句由but连接，第一个分句为there be句型，第二个分句用现在进行时表示趋势。

sentences.en: The question of can I win in November is, is a question that voters alone can answer.
sentences.cn: 我能否在十一月获胜的问题，是只有选民才能回答的问题。
sentences.structure: 主语（The question of can I win in November）+ 系动词（is）+ 表语（a question）+ 定语从句（that voters alone can answer）
sentences.analysis: 主语中包含of介词短语，其中'can I win'为疑问句作宾语，表语后接that引导的定语从句。

sentences.en: Electability is the thing that's best defined after the fact.
sentences.cn: 可选举性是在事后才能最好定义的东西。
sentences.structure: 主语（Electability）+ 系动词（is）+ 表语（the thing）+ 定语从句（that's best defined...）
sentences.analysis: 定语从句修饰'the thing'，'after the fact'表示'事后'。

sentences.en: And so, I'm wondering if we're at the beginning of a movement that ends with some version of that for Democrats, someone that they thought was not electable, who suddenly is.
sentences.cn: 所以，我在想我们是否正处于一场运动的开端，这场运动最终会以某种形式出现在民主党人身上，一个他们曾认为没有当选可能的人，突然变得有当选可能。
sentences.structure: 主句（I'm wondering）+ 宾语从句（if we're...）+ 定语从句（that ends...）+ 同位语（someone）+ 定语从句（that they thought...）+ 非限制性定语从句（who suddenly is）
sentences.analysis: if引导宾语从句，'that ends with'修饰movement，'someone'是'that'的同位语，后接两个定语从句，第二个定语从句中省略了'electable'。

sentences.en: The conventional wisdom is Mike Rogers is very delighted to have El-Sayed as his opponent, but it's not entirely clear that that's the case.
sentences.cn: 传统观点认为，迈克·罗杰斯非常高兴有埃尔-萨耶德作为对手，但情况是否如此并不完全清楚。
sentences.structure: 并列句（The conventional wisdom is... but...）
sentences.analysis: 第一个分句中，'is'后接表语从句，第二个分句用it作形式主语，that从句为真正主语。

sentences.en: She's the only one in the race that's actually been elected.
sentences.cn: 她是竞选中唯一真正当选过的人。
sentences.structure: 主句（She's the only one）+ 定语从句（that's actually been elected）
sentences.analysis: 定语从句修饰'the only one'，'that'在从句中作主语。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, there's nobody else in the race at this time that has that cache.
sentences.cn: 不幸的是，目前竞选中没有其他人拥有那种声望。
sentences.structure: There be句型 + 定语从句（that has that cache）
sentences.analysis: 定语从句修饰'nobody else'，'that'在从句中作主语。

sentences.en: The strategy that the Stevens campaign is running is to try to run up turnout in Black majority areas in Michigan.
sentences.cn: 史蒂文斯竞选团队正在执行的策略是试图提高密歇根州黑人占多数地区的投票率。
sentences.structure: 主语（The strategy）+ 定语从句（that the Stevens campaign is running）+ 系动词（is）+ 表语（to try to run up...）
sentences.analysis: 定语从句修饰strategy，表语为不定式短语。

sentences.en: And the polling shows him ahead, but it's just sort of a guess by the pollsters about is it going to be young male white voters? Is it going to be older female black voters?
sentences.cn: 民调显示他领先，但这只是民调专家的一种猜测，会是年轻的白人男性选民吗？会是年长的黑人女性选民吗？
sentences.structure: 并列句（the polling shows... but...）+ 介词短语（about...）
sentences.analysis: 第一个分句为简单句，第二个分句'it's just sort of a guess'，后接about介词短语，其中包含两个疑问句作宾语。

sentences.en: President Trump publicly standing by embattled Republican Congressman Max Miller, even as his former press secretary launches a new legal battle against Miller.
sentences.cn: 特朗普总统公开支持陷入困境的共和党众议员马克斯·米勒，尽管他的前新闻秘书对米勒发起了新的法律诉讼。
sentences.structure: 独立主格结构（President Trump publicly standing by...）+ 让步状语从句（even as...）
sentences.analysis: 独立主格结构由名词+现在分词构成，表示伴随情况，'even as'引导让步状语从句。

sentences.en: In a "Washington Post" op-ed, Grisham had written about abuse allegations dealing with an ex-boyfriend, and Miller sued her at the time, but they settled out of court and agreed not to disparage each other publicly.
sentences.cn: 在《华盛顿邮报》的一篇专栏文章中，格里沙姆曾写过关于前男友的虐待指控，米勒当时起诉了她，但他们庭外和解，并同意不公开诋毁对方。
sentences.structure: 并列句（Grisham had written... and Miller sued... but they settled...）
sentences.analysis: 三个分句由and和but连接，第一个分句为过去完成时，第二个分句为一般过去时，第三个分句为一般过去时。

sentences.en: What should be noted is that allegation came out on the same day as somebody's book launch.
sentences.cn: 值得注意的是，这一指控是在某人新书发布当天出现的。
sentences.structure: 主语从句（What should be noted）+ 系动词（is）+ 表语从句（that allegation came out...）
sentences.analysis: What引导主语从句，that引导表语从句，'the same day as'表示'与...同一天'。

sentences.en: And she, in her own words, will tell you that I never did any of those things.
sentences.cn: 而且她，用她自己的话说，会告诉你我从未做过那些事。
sentences.structure: 主语（she）+ 插入语（in her own words）+ 谓语（will tell）+ 间接宾语（you）+ 宾语从句（that I never did...）
sentences.analysis: 插入语' in her own words'表示'用她自己的话'，that引导宾语从句。

sentences.en: It appears this was a confidential agreement.
sentences.cn: 看来这是一份保密协议。
sentences.structure: 主语（It）+ 系动词（appears）+ 表语从句（this was...）
sentences.analysis: It作形式主语，appears后接表语从句。

sentences.en: And she's saying that in that interview, by denying the claims that she made, as well as the claims by his now ex-wife, that he broke that agreement.
sentences.cn: 她说，在那次采访中，通过否认她提出的指控以及他前妻的指控，他违反了该协议。
sentences.structure: 主句（she's saying）+ 宾语从句（that...he broke...）+ 方式状语（by denying...）
sentences.analysis: that引导宾语从句，'by denying'为方式状语，其中'that she made'为定语从句修饰claims，'as well as'连接并列宾语。

sentences.en: And there is also this audio obtained from earlier this year.
sentences.cn: 还有今年早些时候获得的这段音频。
sentences.structure: There be句型 + 过去分词短语（obtained...）作后置定语
sentences.analysis: 过去分词短语修饰audio。

sentences.en: Emily Moreno is telling police about an incident on New Year's Eve where she alleged that Miller held a gun to her head when she was changing their infant daughter.
sentences.cn: 艾米丽·莫雷诺正在向警方讲述新年夜发生的一起事件，她声称米勒在她给婴儿女儿换尿布时用枪指着她的头。
sentences.structure: 主句（Emily Moreno is telling police about an incident）+ 定语从句（where she alleged...）+ 时间状语从句（when she was changing...）
sentences.analysis: where引导定语从句修饰incident，从句中that引导宾语从句，宾语从句中又包含when引导的时间状语从句。

sentences.en: And I think that's part of the problem is that he keeps releasing more and more information and more evidence that can then be used against him in certain cases.
sentences.cn: 我认为部分问题在于他不断发布越来越多的信息和证据，这些信息和证据在特定情况下可能会对他不利。
sentences.structure: 主句（I think）+ 宾语从句（that's part of the problem）+ 表语从句（that he keeps...）+ 定语从句（that can then be used...）
sentences.analysis: 第一个that引导宾语从句，第二个that引导表语从句，第三个that引导定语从句修饰evidence。

sentences.en: Bernie Moreno didn't say anything for a very long time.
sentences.cn: 伯尼·莫雷诺在很长一段时间内没有说任何话。
sentences.structure: 主语（Bernie Moreno）+ 谓语（didn't say）+ 宾语（anything）+ 时间状语（for a very long time）
sentences.analysis: 简单句，否定形式。

sentences.en: I hope you never have to go through a situation like this and you wouldn't ask that kind of effing question.
sentences.cn: 我希望你永远不必经历这样的情况，你也不会问那种该死的问题。
sentences.structure: 主句（I hope）+ 宾语从句（you never have to... and you wouldn't ask...）
sentences.analysis: hope后接两个并列的宾语从句。

sentences.en: And I think it's a great example of the fact that they do want this not to be so public.
sentences.cn: 我认为这是一个很好的例子，说明他们确实不希望这件事如此公开。
sentences.structure: 主句（I think）+ 宾语从句（it's a great example）+ 同位语从句（that they do want...）
sentences.analysis: that引导同位语从句修饰fact，'do'用于强调。

sentences.en: Just because you're a senator don't mean you're up for elections every six years.
sentences.cn: 仅仅因为你是参议员并不意味着你每六年就要参加选举。
sentences.structure: 原因状语从句（Just because...）+ 主句（don't mean...）
sentences.analysis: because引导原因状语从句，主句为否定形式，后接宾语从句。

sentences.en: But when you put that on the screen, an ad maker like me can run that against -- he's running against an ironworker, a regular union guy, and that makes that be more vulnerable.
sentences.cn: 但当你把它放到屏幕上时，像我这样的广告制作人就可以利用这一点来攻击——他的对手是一名钢铁工人，一个普通的工会成员，这让他更加脆弱。
sentences.structure: 时间状语从句（when you put...）+ 主句（an ad maker...can run...）+ 并列句（and that makes...）
sentences.analysis: when引导时间状语从句，主句为'can run that against'，破折号后解释说明，and连接并列句。

sentences.en: That's why you have to put politics in this horrible situation where you're talking about guns and babies, which nobody should live through.
sentences.cn: 这就是为什么你必须把政治置于这种可怕的境地，谈论枪支和婴儿，这是任何人都不应该经历的。
sentences.structure: 表语从句（That's why...）+ 定语从句（where you're talking...）+ 非限制性定语从句（which nobody...）
sentences.analysis: why引导表语从句，where引导定语从句修饰situation，which引导非限制性定语从句修饰整个主句。

sentences.en: The ethics committee is recommending a full vote to censure North Carolina's Chuck Edwards, a months-long probe found that Edwards engaged in persistent, inappropriate conduct toward two young female staffers.
sentences.cn: 道德委员会建议对北卡罗来纳州的查克·爱德华兹进行全体投票谴责，一项长达数月的调查发现，爱德华兹对两名年轻女职员持续存在不当行为。
sentences.structure: 主句（The ethics committee is recommending...）+ 同位语（a months-long probe found...）
sentences.analysis: 同位语部分为完整句子，'found'后接that宾语从句。

sentences.en: They claim that the ethics committee failed to demonstrate that either of the two staffers actually expressed discomfort to Edwards regarding his conduct with them.
sentences.cn: 他们声称，道德委员会未能证明这两名职员中的任何一人曾就爱德华兹对他们的行为向他表达过不适。
sentences.structure: 主句（They claim）+ 宾语从句（that the ethics committee failed...）+ 宾语从句（that either...expressed...）
sentences.analysis: 第一个that引导宾语从句，第二个that引导宾语从句作demonstrate的宾语。

sentences.en: I remember thinking, Jorge Santos is not going to have to leave Congress unless a Democrat also is a problem, and they can be asked to leave Congress.
sentences.cn: 我记得当时在想，乔治·桑托斯不必离开国会，除非民主党人也有问题，他们可以被要求离开国会。
sentences.structure: 主句（I remember thinking）+ 宾语从句（Jorge Santos is not going to...）+ 条件状语从句（unless...）
sentences.analysis: remember后接动名词thinking，后接宾语从句，unless引导条件状语从句。

sentences.en: And I think this is where the American people are fed up with both parties.
sentences.cn: 我认为这就是美国人民对两党都感到厌倦的地方。
sentences.structure: 主句（I think）+ 宾语从句（this is where...）
sentences.analysis: where引导表语从句。

sentences.en: When you say, what do you think about Democrats? What do you think about Republicans? You're like, well, they're all too old, and they're all a bunch of crooks that seem like they're acting like a bunch of freaks on Capitol Hill.
sentences.cn: 当你说，你对民主党怎么看？你对共和党怎么看？你会说，嗯，他们都太老了，而且他们都是一群骗子，看起来就像一群在国会山上胡闹的怪人。
sentences.structure: 时间状语从句（When you say...）+ 主句（You're like...）
sentences.analysis: when引导时间状语从句，其中包含两个疑问句，主句为'You're like'，后接直接引语。

sentences.en: I just -- it is strange to me that, you know, even if it is true what his office is saying, that none of these people ever complained about this, that one would think it's appropriate to shower young female staffers and these kinds of gifts and invite them to things, it's just, you know, it's strange.
sentences.cn: 我只是——对我来说很奇怪，你知道，即使他的办公室所说的是真的，这些人中没有人抱怨过这件事，人们会认为给年轻女职员送这些礼物并邀请她们参加活动是合适的，这很奇怪。
sentences.structure: 主句（it is strange to me that...）+ 让步状语从句（even if...）+ 同位语从句（that none...）+ 结果状语从句（that one would think...）
sentences.analysis: it作形式主语，that引导主语从句，其中包含even if引导的让步状语从句，以及两个that从句。

sentences.en: I think there is some credit that is actually due here to Speaker Johnson, who I would say probably saying nobody who works in Congress can date anybody else who works in Congress is maybe a little bit of an overcorrection.
sentences.cn: 我认为议长约翰逊确实值得一些赞扬，我想说，也许说在国会工作的人不能与在国会工作的其他人约会可能有点过度纠正。
sentences.structure: 主句（I think）+ 宾语从句（there is some credit...）+ 定语从句（that is actually due...）+ 非限制性定语从句（who I would say...）
sentences.analysis: that引导定语从句修饰credit，who引导非限制性定语从句修饰Johnson，其中包含宾语从句。

sentences.en: And that ethics committee is the one that dealt down this decision.
sentences.cn: 而那个道德委员会就是做出这一决定的委员会。
sentences.structure: 主句（that ethics committee is the one）+ 定语从句（that dealt down...）
sentences.analysis: that引导定语从句修饰the one。

sentences.en: So, you know, I respect the fact and appreciate that there is at least an effort here to clean up house and recognition that there is a problem.
sentences.cn: 所以，你知道，我尊重这一事实，并赞赏这里至少有一种努力来整顿内部，并认识到存在问题。
sentences.structure: 主句（I respect the fact and appreciate that...）+ 同位语从句（that there is...）
sentences.analysis: appreciate后接that宾语从句，'recognition'后接that同位语从句。

sentences.en: And if Democrats take the House, which they probably will, at least in the house, it'd be interesting to watch how they deal -- how they deal with the ethics committee on either side.
sentences.cn: 如果民主党拿下众议院，他们很可能会，至少在众议院，那么观察他们如何处理——他们如何处理双方的道德委员会将会很有趣。
sentences.structure: 条件状语从句（if Democrats take...）+ 非限制性定语从句（which they probably will）+ 主句（it'd be interesting...）
sentences.analysis: if引导条件状语从句，which引导非限制性定语从句，主句为it作形式主语，不定式短语为真正主语。

sentences.en: Since you were here, we want to give you something positive to talk about what is in your group chat other than people being like, oh my God, did you talk to this lawmaker?
sentences.cn: 既然你在这里，我们想给你一些积极的东西来谈谈你的群聊里有什么，而不是人们像这样，哦，我的上帝，你和这位议员谈过吗？
sentences.structure: 原因状语从句（Since you were here）+ 主句（we want to give...）+ 不定式短语（to talk about...）
sentences.analysis: since引导原因状语从句，不定式短语作目的状语，'other than'表示'除了'。

sentences.en: But I think, you know, we're talking a lot about how the House, the Senate are going out.
sentences.cn: 但我认为，你知道，我们谈论很多关于众议院和参议院如何结束会议。
sentences.structure: 主句（I think）+ 宾语从句（we're talking...）+ 宾语从句（how...）
sentences.analysis: how引导宾语从句作about的宾语。

sentences.en: And it's going to be such a rush when they come back in September.
sentences.cn: 当他们九月回来时，将会非常匆忙。
sentences.structure: 主句（it's going to be such a rush）+ 时间状语从句（when they come back...）
sentences.analysis: when引导时间状语从句。

sentences.en: If you look at the trades that happened this week ahead of the trade deadline, the rich get richer.
sentences.cn: 如果你看看本周交易截止日期前发生的交易，富人变得更富。
sentences.structure: 条件状语从句（If you look at...）+ 主句（the rich get richer）
sentences.analysis: if引导条件状语从句，其中that引导定语从句修饰trades。

sentences.en: The Minnesota Twins need to have a level playing field to be able to compete with those teams.
sentences.cn: 明尼苏达双城队需要有一个公平的竞争环境才能与这些球队竞争。
sentences.structure: 主语（The Minnesota Twins）+ 谓语（need to have）+ 宾语（a level playing field）+ 目的状语（to be able to...）
sentences.analysis: 不定式短语作目的状语。

sentences.en: And look at these are great Latino candidates who are up in marginal seats.
sentences.cn: 看看这些优秀的拉丁裔候选人，他们正在争夺边缘席位。
sentences.structure: 祈使句（look at）+ 宾语从句（these are...）+ 定语从句（who are up...）
sentences.analysis: look at后接宾语从句，who引导定语从句修饰candidates。

sentences.en: If Democrats take back Congress, it will be because --
sentences.cn: 如果民主党夺回国会，那将是因为——
sentences.structure: 条件状语从句（If Democrats take back Congress）+ 主句（it will be because...）
sentences.analysis: if引导条件状语从句，主句为it will be because，后接原因。

sentences.en: Given ICE and all these things and the miscalculation in the past of left activists about thinking Latinos care about immigration so much, I'm really interested to see.
sentences.cn: 鉴于ICE和所有这些事情，以及过去左翼活动人士错误地认为拉丁裔非常关心移民问题，我真的很感兴趣。
sentences.structure: 介词短语（Given...）+ 主句（I'm really interested to see）
sentences.analysis: Given为介词，后接名词短语，主句为简单句。

sentences.en: I'm so thrown off because I was going to say the thing about the MLB salary cap.
sentences.cn: 我太困惑了，因为我本来要说关于MLB工资帽的事情。
sentences.structure: 主句（I'm so thrown off）+ 原因状语从句（because I was going to say...）
sentences.analysis: because引导原因状语从句，'be going to'表示过去打算。

sentences.en: And this Spider-Man movie was really quality.
sentences.cn: 这部蜘蛛侠电影质量真的很高。
sentences.structure: 主语（this Spider-Man movie）+ 系动词（was）+ 表语（really quality）
sentences.analysis: 简单句，quality作形容词。

sentences.en: The world is smaller.
sentences.cn: 世界更小了。
sentences.structure: 主语（The world）+ 系动词（is）+ 表语（smaller）
sentences.analysis: 简单句，比较级。

sentences.en: There's not like aliens from other dimensions coming in and messing up timelines.
sentences.cn: 不像来自其他维度的外星人进来扰乱时间线。
sentences.structure: There be句型 + 介词短语（like aliens...）+ 现在分词短语（coming in and messing up...）
sentences.analysis: like后接名词，现在分词短语作后置定语。

sentences.en: Has it already come out?
sentences.cn: 已经上映了吗？
sentences.structure: 现在完成时疑问句
sentences.analysis: 现在完成时表示过去动作对现在的影响。

sentences.en: I don't blame you because the hype and run up to these things is just so long.
sentences.cn: 我不怪你，因为对这些事情的炒作和预热时间太长了。
sentences.structure: 主句（I don't blame you）+ 原因状语从句（because...）
sentences.analysis: because引导原因状语从句。

sentences.en: And it also means both Zendaya and Tom Holland, who may or may not be married, but they probably are, have two top box office films with "The Odyssey" and "Brand New Day".
sentences.cn: 这也意味着赞达亚和汤姆·霍兰德，他们可能结婚也可能没有，但很可能结婚了，有两部顶级票房电影《奥德赛》和《崭新的一天》。
sentences.structure: 主句（it also means...）+ 宾语从句（both Zendaya and Tom Holland...have...）+ 非限制性定语从句（who may or may not be married...）
sentences.analysis: means后接宾语从句，who引导非限制性定语从句，插入语'but they probably are'。
